name: young-dragon
description: A wireframe cube loader that tumbles in space using outlined faces and semantic tokens.
purpose: Marks an in-progress wait with a geometric 3D cube instead of a flat ring, still reading in light and dark.
bestFor: playful async waits that still need a status role
compact pending markers beside a short label
avoidFor: determinate progress with a known percentage
dense toolbars that need a hairline spinner
